subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw expose ordered fallback verification as an explicit mode of the existing model probe surface, or as a separate `/models` diagnostic command?
rationale: Both this issue and the broader health-check request need real provider calls, but they answer different operator questions; choosing one public command shape and output contract prevents overlapping diagnostics with conflicting semantics.

options.title: Add an ordered probe mode
options.body: Extend the current probe surface with an explicit mode that skips the primary and reports each configured fallback in runtime order.

options.title: Add a separate slash diagnostic
options.body: Create `/models test-fallback` only if maintainers want an interactive agent-scoped workflow distinct from CLI status diagnostics.

options.title: Fold into broader health checks
options.body: Treat this as a requirement of the per-model health-check work, while preserving explicit ordered-fallback semantics in its design.

recommendation.title: Add an ordered probe mode
recommendation.body: Extend the current probe surface with an explicit mode that skips the primary and reports each configured fallback in runtime order.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion already contains a detailed acceptance-oriented review from this fallback and model-status area contributor.
